name: Exp_breakeven_trailing_SL
summary: This EA is a position management utility that automatically moves stop loss to breakeven when a position reaches a specified profit threshold, then applies a trailing stop to lock in further gains. It does not open any trades itself; it only modifies existing stop loss levels via CTrade::PositionModify. It supports filtering by symbol and magic number.
summary_zh: 该EA是一个仓位管理工具，当持仓达到指定盈利点数时自动将止损移至保本价位，随后应用追踪止损锁定更多利润。它不自行开仓，仅通过CTrade::PositionModify修改现有持仓的止损水平，支持按品种和魔数筛选。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略概念是保护已获利润，分为保本和追踪止损两个阶段。入场条件不适用，因为该工具不会自行开仓，仅管理已有持仓。出场条件方面，保本阶段：当买价（Bid）超过开仓价加PlusPoints_breakeven点数时，将止损移至开仓价加StepSL_plus_breakeven点数；卖单类似。追踪止损阶段：当价格继续有利移动超过PlusPoints_trail点数时，止损按StepSL_plus_trail步长跟随移动。仓位管理不涉及，因为不负责开仓。资金管理同样不涉及，但该工具通过逐步锁定利润来间接保护资金。止损修改时考虑了SYMBOL_TRADE_STOPS_LEVEL最小止损距离限制，防止因止损距离过近被拒绝。
strategy_analysis_en: The core concept of this EA is profit protection, divided into breakeven and trailing stop phases. Entry conditions are not applicable since this utility does not open positions; it only manages existing ones. For exit conditions, in the breakeven phase: when Bid exceeds open price plus PlusPoints_breakeven points, the SL is moved to open price plus StepSL_plus_breakeven points; sell positions work symmetrically with Ask. In the trailing phase: when price continues favorably beyond PlusPoints_trail points, the SL follows in steps of StepSL_plus_trail. Position sizing is not applicable as the EA does not open trades. Money management is also not directly applicable, but the tool indirectly protects capital by progressively locking in profits. The stop loss modification respects SYMBOL_TRADE_STOPS_LEVEL minimum distance requirements, preventing rejection due to stops being too close to current price.

parameters.name: WorkSymb
parameters.description: 工作品种：当前品种或所有品种
parameters.description_en: Working symbol: current or all symbols

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: 魔数：-1为所有仓位，0为手动仓位，>0为指定EA仓位
parameters.description_en: Magic number: -1 all positions, 0 manual, >0 specific EA

parameters.name: PlusPoints_breakeven
parameters.description: 保本触发点数，0则禁用保本功能

parameters.name: StepSL_plus_breakeven
parameters.description: 保本止损移动步长（超过开仓价的点数），0则禁用
parameters.description_en: Breakeven SL step (points above open price); 0 disables

parameters.name: PlusPoints_trail
parameters.description: 追踪止损触发点数，0则禁用追踪功能
parameters.description_en: Trailing stop trigger points; 0 disables trailing

parameters.name: StepSL_plus_trail
parameters.description: 追踪止损步长点数，0则禁用

pros: 双重保护机制：先保本再追踪，逻辑清晰分层执行
支持多品种同时管理，配合魔数筛选可精确控制目标仓位
止损修改时遵守SYMBOL_TRADE_STOPS_LEVEL限制，避免修改被拒
初始化时进行参数有效性检查，防止不合理配置导致异常行为
pros_en: Dual protection mechanism: breakeven first then trailing, with clear layered execution logic
Supports multi-symbol management with magic number filtering for precise position targeting
Respects SYMBOL_TRADE_STOPS_LEVEL minimum distance when modifying stops, preventing broker rejection
Validates input parameters during initialization to prevent unreasonable configurations
cons: 缺少PositionModify返回值检查，无法确认止损修改是否成功执行
每个tick都遍历所有仓位并调用SymbolInfoDouble/Integer获取行情数据，效率较低
没有新bar检测机制，同一bar内可能频繁触发无意义的修改请求
保本和追踪参数使用点数而非实际点值，不同品种需要分别调整参数
缺少点差过滤，在点差较大时可能立即触发保本或追踪逻辑
cons_en: No return value check on PositionModify, so failed stop modifications go unnoticed
Iterates all positions and calls SymbolInfoDouble/Integer every tick, which is inefficient
No new bar detection, potentially triggering redundant modification requests within the same bar
Parameters use raw points rather than point value, requiring separate tuning per instrument
No spread filter, so large spreads could immediately trigger breakeven or trailing logic
improvements: 添加PositionModify返回值检查和错误日志记录，确保止损修改成功执行
引入新bar检测或定时器机制，减少不必要的频繁遍历和行情请求
增加点差过滤和滑点保护，避免在点差异常时进行止损修改
improvements_en: Add PositionModify return value checking and error logging to confirm stop modifications succeed
Introduce new bar detection or timer mechanism to reduce unnecessary frequent iteration and quote requests
Add spread filter and slippage protection to avoid stop modifications during abnormal spread conditions

risk_points: 不检查PositionModify返回值，止损修改失败时无法感知，可能误以为仓位已被保护
无点差过滤，极端行情下止损修改可能因止损距离不足被拒绝
risk_points_en: Not checking PositionModify return values means failed stop modifications go unnoticed, falsely assuming positions are protected
No spread filter means stop modifications could be rejected during extreme market conditions due to insufficient stop distance
